scientific_integrity: Mathematical reasoning establishes the infinite theorem. Finite enumeration and quotient-chain calculations corroborate selected cases but are not substituted for proof. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the fundamental group and integral first homology only for the critical cycle C_{2d} and d>=3. No higher integral homology, integral quotient homotopy type, or generalization to all cycle lengths is claimed. The standard orbit-space fundamental-group theorem and the previously known underlying sphere and rational orientation results are cited, not claimed as new. Unindexed equivalent applications remain a residual literature risk.
title: Prime-power torsion in cyclic quotients of bounded-independence spheres
